Maanshan Golin Press Brake Tooling Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is located in Bowang Town-China’s leading town for cutting tools and dies. The company has over 120 employees, 23 years of manufacturing experience, and covers 12,000 square meters, including 8,000 square meters of modern workshops.
